name: Dev-Review Loop — build, review, iterate until PASS
description: Full pipeline with conditional iteration: developer builds, verifier reviews. FAIL → developer fixes. PASS → done.

nodes.body_template: Write a Python function `calculate_total(items)` in calculate.py that takes a list of prices and returns the sum. Handle empty list (return 0). Include test_calculate.py.
Review calculate.py. Run the tests. Is the implementation correct? Set verdict to PASS or FAIL.
The verifier found issues. Fix calculate.py based on the review feedback and resubmit.
Re-review the fixed calculate.py. Set verdict to PASS or FAIL.
Final QA: run all tests and verify the calculate function works correctly.
